dates.event: Online Registration & Fee Payment Last Date

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) under the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registering on NATS, apply for the UCO Bank Apprenticeship Program on the NATS portal.
Candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC (info@bfsissc.com) inviting them to fill in detailed application information and make payment for the Online Examination at https://beep.bfsissc.com.
Pay the requisite non-refundable Application/Examination fee through ONLINE mode only from 14-10-2026 to 29-10-2026.
Appear for the Online Entrance Examination conducted by BFSI SSC on 07-11-2026 at 11 AM.
Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE State/UT only.
Keep the NATS Enrolment ID safe for all future correspondence.
No hard copy of application or documents is to be sent to the Bank’s office.

title: Income Tax Department TN and Puducherry Recruitment 2026 – Stenographer Gr.I Posts
shortInfo: Income Tax Department TN and Puducherry has announced notification for Stenographer Gr.I posts. Required qualification: Any Graduate. Last date to apply: 30-10-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Application

howToApply: Eligible candidates should fill the prescribed proforma application.
Attach Photo copies of APARs for the last five years duly attested (with stamp) on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or equivalent, including NRC.
Attach Major/Minor penalty statement for the last 10 years.
Attach Cadre Clearance incorporating that in the event of selection, the candidate will be relieved to join the post of Stenographer Gr.I in Income Tax Department on deputation basis.
Send the application through proper channel (Head of Office/Department must verify and certify eligibility criteria).
Applications to be addressed to: Commissioner of Income Tax (Admin & TPS), O/o Pr. CCIT, Tamil Nadu & Puducherry, Ponni Block, 121, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai-600034.
Applications must reach on or before 30-10-2026.
